How a top-up works

  1. Choose an amountYou see the exact coins and any bonus before you pay.
  2. Send it with InstaPayThe quoted amount, once, with your Lightning email as the note.
  3. Upload your receiptWe match it to the money that arrived, then add your coins.

Payments are checked by hand. Don’t send another transfer while one is being reviewed. Help: hello@lightningeg.com

Choose your amount

Enter an amount to see the exact coins and any bonus.

Payment and purchase terms

Coins are credits for Lightning cosmetics. Top-ups and cosmetic purchases are final; discretionary refunds are not offered. Mandatory legal rights and manual review of duplicate transfers, payment errors or failed delivery remain available. Your financial app data stays on your devices.

Send the exact quoted EGP amount once, using your Lightning account email as the transfer note. Upload your own receipt. A picture alone never confirms payment. Contact support before sending more money while a payment is being reviewed.

Send the payment

In InstaPay, send the amount to our address and paste your Lightning email in the note. Then upload your receipt below.

Upload your receipt

A screenshot of the InstaPay or wallet confirmation: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 5 MB. Sent it in two parts? Upload the latest one and tell support; don’t send the full amount again.
